terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.acceptance-text: By accessing or using SpotGo, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
terms.accounts-text: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use.
terms.usage-text: You agree not to misuse the service, interfere with its operations, or attempt to access it using unauthorized methods.
terms.parking-text: Reservations are subject to availability. SpotGo does not guarantee the availability of parking spots. Fees are non-refundable unless stated otherwise.
terms.privacy-text: Your use of the service is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which describes how we collect and use your data.
terms.termination-text: We may suspend or terminate your access to the service at any time for conduct that violates these terms.
terms.disclaimer-text: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. SpotGo is not liable for any damages arising from your use of the service.
terms.changes-text: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
terms.contact-text: Questions about these Terms? Contact us at support@spotgo.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction-text: This Privacy Policy describes how SpotGo collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our service.
privacy.collection-text: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email, phone number, and payment method. We also collect usage data including parking history and device information.
privacy.usage-text: We use your information to provide and improve the service, process reservations and payments, send notifications, and ensure security.
privacy.sharing-text: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with service providers who assist in operating the platform, as required by law.
privacy.security-text: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
privacy.retention-text: We retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the service. You may request deletion at any time.
privacy.rights-text: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Contact us to exercise these rights.
privacy.cookies-text: We use cookies and similar technologies to maintain your session and improve your experience.
privacy.changes-text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes.
privacy.contact-text: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact us at privacy@spotgo.com.
